execution: one process at a time, one fixed available CPU, randomized condition order within each repetition
owned_result: each invocation returns a complete fresh TableEntry, retaining no mutable input bytes and sharing no mutable output messages with other invocations
raw_scope: numeric identifiers and pre-encoded values, no name lookup or P4Info checks, clone incoming bytes

reuse_scope.sdk: Builder and its table definition and match map

copy_scope.legacy: adapter clones match values, masks, bounds, action parameter bytes and metadata before handing them to the native API
copy_scope.raw-current: adapter copies input byte values into new protobufs
copy_scope.raw-legacy: adapter copies input byte values into new protobufs
copy_scope.finsy: native encode_entry produces a fresh protobuf from immutable numeric input values
copy_scope.shell: native msg constructs a fresh protobuf; no adapter-level protobuf clone

components_interpretation: costs of public operations measured separately, not an additive or causal decomposition of complete construction
python_gc: enabled, collect after calibration before measurement

statistics.summary: arithmetic mean, sample SD, median, min, max
statistics.pairs: per-repetition SDK or legacy ns/op divided by corresponding raw ns/op, and reused divided by new for each tool

exclusions: no removal of slow or unfavorable completed measurements; failed or incomplete executions stay in the run record
scope: offline valid TableEntry construction; excludes protobuf wire serialization, WriteRequest preparation, SDK Write validation and cloning, RPC, and target execution
